title: Document list
html:
It contains every document recorded in the system by filing. Here you can view, search and download the documents. Infinity stores the filing user, the last person who modified the document and the date of modification.

7.2.1Filing a new document

When filing a new document, the first task is to select the filing type — this determines the data required for recording and the screen that appears.

After selecting the type, give the document a name, select the related partner and attach the file.
